meta.topic: Make reels and explainers: point your agent at the social-explainer-reel repo
meta.thesis: To make social reels or explainer videos, open the social-explainer-reel repository and tell your agent to use the skill.
meta.misconception_note: The hook flips the belief that one AI video tool should make the whole reel; beat 1 names it, beats 2 to 5 show the layered mechanism that replaces it.
meta.notes: v2 (2026-10-21), built by the skill itself. Human host: one fictional portrait (nano-banana-pro) animated by veo-3.1-fast, one clip per beat or run of beats, the host's own speech is the master clock (host_assemble.py). Overlays: HTML page over host frames, rendered with render_html.py (route L, no HyperFrames). Mix: mix_audio.py (host audio untouched, synthesised bed and cues). Transitions: a morph from full frame to a circular bubble, no flashes. Authorisation: the user said to use the ImagineArt MCP and asked for a human host; cap 4500 credits set by the agent, spent 3278 credits (credits ledger, amounts are credits). AI-content label: ON, an AI-generated photoreal presenter appears (provenance.json). The repo URL on screen points to the public repository. Accepted lint warnings: host-broll's 1.2-3.5 s beat band is exceeded (4.4-6.1 s per beat) because each beat is one thought spoken in one clip, and the pace is carried by an overlay change about every second; beat 4 is marked allow_long. Beat 6 shows its 5 words as kinetic type over a silent-looking pause.
meta.visual_anchor: A fictional presenter in his early 30s, charcoal overshirt, tidy studio with softly blurred shelves and a deep blue practical light; no flags, logos, brands or text.

claims.text: The skill mixes 4 layers: code-rendered graphics, AI imagery and video, stock or real footage, and a host or recurring cast, giving each beat to the layer that is reliable for it.
Code draws numbers, labels, diagrams and equations exactly; a generative model never renders them.
The skill picks 1 of 15 formats and writes a linted beat map.
Every paid generation is priced from the environment and the ledger refuses it until the plan gate is approved and the budget cap allows it.
Install from the repo (the .skill file, the plugin marketplace, or a clone), then ask the agent to use social-explainer-reel; the user gets master.mp4 after approving the plan.
Code gives exactness, AI gives atmosphere, real footage gives proof, and a host gives a human reason to stay.
